verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal documents fleet management: readers are registered by serial number, registration code, or order number, and multiple readers across sites are organized with locations and zones. The locations-and-zones doc is the API variant of that page. However, configuring and monitoring readers is only documented as a Dashboard feature, and no evidence shows API endpoints for reader status or remote configuration. Missing for 10: explicit API-based reader status monitoring, API-based remote configuration updates, explicit API registration endpoint docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of programmatic fleet management.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage a fleet of readers and terminals via API — register devices, monitor status, and update configuration remotely

citations.quote: You can streamline the management of multiple readers across different physical sites by using locations and zones.
You can register readers using their serial number. This method doesn’t require someone to physically have the reader to register it
You can register smart readers in one of three ways: - Registration code - Serial number - Order number
